scientific_limitations: One-dimensional nearest-neighbor local resetting at positive uniform rate only.
Annealed stationary correlation over a symmetric two-state Markov template with parameter -1<=c<=1; quenched signs are not classified.
The zero of the nearest-neighbor correlation is not a thermodynamic phase transition.
Broader quenched-disorder literature may contain a stronger equivalent specialization; independent priority review remains necessary.
title: Exact sign-reversal boundary for correlations in a locally reset voter chain
